### Compose applies the selected operations in order > In practice, we will combine multiple image augmentation methods. [D2L, Combining Multiple Image Augmentation Methods](https://d2l.ai/chapter_computer-vision/image-augmentation.html#combining-multiple-image-augmentation-methods), CC BY-SA 4.0. The following original PyTorch excerpts use the earlier `apply` helper, `shape_aug`, the source photograph `img`, and `torchvision`. ```python title="D2L source excerpts: colour transform and composition" color_aug = torchvision.transforms.ColorJitter( brightness=0.5, contrast=0.5, saturation=0.5, hue=0.5) augs = torchvision.transforms.Compose([ torchvision.transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(), color_aug, shape_aug]) apply(img, augs) ``` ![[00 Учебник/Assets/Figures/curated/augmentation-composition-2026-11-03/d2l-composed-transforms.svg|Original D2L PyTorch gallery of reflection, colour jitter and resized crop]] *Aston Zhang, Zachary C. Lipton, Mu Li and Alexander J. Smola, [D2L, Combining Multiple Image Augmentation Methods](https://d2l.ai/chapter_computer-vision/image-augmentation.html#combining-multiple-image-augmentation-methods), [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Complete original eight-panel PyTorch output, unchanged. This saved gallery shows repeated calls to the fixed composition above; it is not an AutoAugment search result or a local recognition experiment.* The pipeline first samples horizontal reflection, then colour changes, then a crop that is resized to the output dimensions. Each panel comes from the same list of operations, with new random choices. In the final panel, only a small part of the cat remains; a valid output size does not ensure that the original class is still recognizable. `Compose` specifies how to apply this list. Choosing the list and its parameters is still a separate task. AutoAugment searches over such choices, while RandAugment restricts which policy parameters are tuned. ### AutoAugment separates policy search from final training In [AutoAugment, §3]
### RandAugment tunes the operation count and shared magnitude [RandAugment, §3](https://arxiv.org/html/1909.13719v2#S3) uses
